mapper.select: select plugin_id from pw_plugin_install where user_id = #{userId} and deck_id = #{deckId}
mapper.insert: insert into pw_plugin_install (user_id, deck_id, plugin_id, installed_at) values (#{userId}, #{deckId}, #{pluginId}, NOW()) on conflict (user_id, deck_id, plugin_id) do nothing
mapper.delete: delete from pw_plugin_install where user_id = #{userId} and deck_id = #{deckId} and plugin_id = #{pluginId}
